content: LLM async worker pipelines: most LLM retries are billable once they reach the model, so retry storms become cost storms; Google SRE warns automatic retries overload degraded backends and cascade. Needs: bounded execution (deadlines, max completions), circuit breaker on provider 5xx/429, jitter on backoff, poison-message dead-lettering, per-tenant budget metering on tokens (prompt+completion) not HTTP calls, and anomaly detection for runaway loops/retry spikes.
